result.stdout:
agentrecall - local-first memory and learning for AI coding agents

Usage:
  agentrecall <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                 Create the local data directory and database
  feedback add         Record feedback and extract a pending rule
  rules list           List all rules
  rules show <id>      Show a single rule in detail
  rules approve <id>   Move a Pending rule to Active
  rules promote <id>   Promote a rule
  rules supersede <oldId> <newId>
                       Replace one rule with another
  rules archive <id>   Archive a rule (excluded from search)
  search "<query>"     Search rules by keyword, ranked
  import build-log <file>
  import test-log <file>
  import lint-log <file>
                       Ingest a failure log into events
  mcp                  Run the MCP server over stdio (for Claude Code)
  status               Show the memory subsystem status
  help                 Show this help text
  version              Show the installed version

feedback add options:
  --task <text>          (required) what the agent was asked to do
  --feedback <text>      (required) the corrective guidance
  --bad-output <text>    the undesirable output
  --fixed-output <text>  the corrected/preferred output
  --scope-level <level>  Global|Language|Repository|Directory|File
  --scope-value <text>   scope identifier (repo, language, path)
  --tags <a,b,c>         comma-separated tags
